newsitem.title: DENMARK: A.P.Moeller brakes Danish shares slide.
newsitem.headline: A.P.Moeller brakes Danish shares slide.

text.p: A.P. Moeller's gains, on its buoyant 1996 results, cushioned Danish share prices against the worst effects of Wall Street woes on Friday, but dealers said that downward pressure might remain after the weekend.
"Higher than expected U.S. producer prices were the reason for the fall. It could continue," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index lost 0.10 point, to 154.08, in overall bourse turnover of 792 million crowns. Its June future rose 0.20 point to 153.00 with 70 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Moeller on Thursday reported firm growth in 1996 profits and forecast further improvement in 1997.
Its D/S Svendborg share finished the day 7,500 crowns up, at 285,000 crowns, while its D/S 1912 sister share gained 7,600 crowns, to 198,000.
Both, however, were off earlier highs, leading dealers to assume that the scope for further gains on Monday was limited.
Heading down on Friday was Sophus Berendsen which reported a sharp drop in earnings on Thursday. It closed down 25 crowns, at 800.00.
